task.ques: Investigate the trade-in value for an iPhone 13 Pro Max on Apple's website.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Apple lists an iPhone 13 Pro Max trade-in value of up to $320 USD on its U.S. website, checked October 27, 2026. This is a maximum estimate: the actual credit depends on the device's condition, year and configuration, and on Apple receiving a device matching the description provided. Credit can go toward a qualifying new purchase or an Apple Gift Card.

Evidence: Apple's iPhone Trade-In Values table states “iPhone 13 Pro Max — Up to $320”; the footnote explains the conditions. Source: https://www.apple.com/shop/browse/overlay/tradein_landing/iphone_values (accessed from https://www.apple.com/shop/trade-in). Screenshot: final.png, showing the model, value and footnote together without an open dialog.
